sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The screeching is gone. The clearing is quiet, the open sky calm. Somewhere west, a city you may never see is waking up safe because of what you did tonight. The Custodian is already shuffling you back toward warmth and food and a fire that does not want anything from you. For the first time since the road, there is nothing chasing you. You won. Sit with that a while.

Gmnotes: Conclusion-only section: no combat, no countdown, no new active crisis. Use epilogue_tone to tune warmth, grief, or relief without changing the reward-first order.
Playertakeaway: You did the hard thing and lived. Take the win, take the level, and take a breath.
Storytakeaway: The story is over, and now it gets to mean something.
Mechanictakeaway: The epilogue uses reward, reflection, report payoff, and hook choice rather than combat or countdown.
